name: flaggems_special_xlog1py
description: Extracted from FlagGems special_xlog1py (aten.special_xlog1py = x * log1p(y)). Binary pointwise. Reference upcasts inputs to float64 (to_reference(..., upcast=True)). Main test draws randn inputs with the second operand clamped to min=-1+1e-6 to stay in domain; boundary tests cover x==0 (=>0) and y==NaN (=>NaN).
